messages:
anya: Kicking off recurring access sprint for Q2. Spreadsheet + runbook: https://redwood.internal/sheets/access-sprint-q2. Goal: close high-risk admin entitlements and record owner evidence by Fri EOD. Quick scan called out org-admins with no owner, legacy svc_acct_admins, and billing-admins.
marco: Do we include service-account KMS bindings in the sweep? last sweep missed cross-account grants.
tessa: Yes include KMS grants — treat project-level KMS roles and Cloud KMS crypto roles as high-risk. Query I'm running to find suspects: ```sql
SELECT principal, role, resource FROM iam_bindings WHERE role LIKE '%admin%' AND last_used < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 90 DAY);
```
jay: I saw a strange KMS grant to svc-ci-runner on 2026-03-15. Log snippet: ```json
{"timestamp":"2026-03-15T11:02:34Z","actor":"svc-ci-runner@infra","action":"grant","resource":"projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/abay/keyA","binding":"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"}
``` I filed AGENT-4821.
anya: @jay thanks — please add AGENT-4821 to the sprint blockers board and tag the row in the sheet. @marco can you run the RBAC sweep across orgs and drop a CSV in the sheet? prioritize entries with last_used = NULL or >90d.
marco: On it. Running sweep now and will upload results. Command I'm using: ```bash
./scripts/rbac_sweep --org=redwood --out=access-sprint-q2.csv --include-service-accounts --min-last-used=90d
``` Expect upload in ~45m.
tessa: Heads-up — we need owner attestation for each removed entitlement for our compliance report. @linda from legal, SOC2 retention window?
linda: SOC2 needs 12 months of evidence. For payments/PCI-adjacent assets keep 3 years. We can accept screenshots + signed ticket notes in the compliance bucket.
security-bot: Reminder: Access sprint items due in 72 hours. Please update the checklist and mark any temporary elevations.
anya: Assigning owners in the sheet now (Owner column updated). If you need temporary access to remediate, request via #access-requests and mark as "temporary" with expiry. Deadline: Fri 2026-03-27 EOD. :spiral_calendar:
